description: List sources and their operations, grouped by domain: stats, transport, environment, energy, economy, law/politics, places/property. Start here. Filter by topic, geo_level (national, nuts2, nuts3, county, local_authority, constituency, lea, ed, small_area, town, point), join_key, has_time_series or text to get matching operations with compact dataset cards (geography, time coverage, cadence, join keys).

geo_level.description: Geography level the data is broken down by, e.g. county, local_authority, lea, ed, small_area, constituency, point.

has_time_series.description: true: data over several periods; false: current or single-period data.

join_key.description: Key the results expose for joining, e.g. county_name, lea_name, ed_code, member_code, eli, lat_lon.

text.description: Words that must all appear in the source, operation or card.

topic.description: Topic, e.g. housing, population, labour, transport, law. Related topics also match.

name: ireland_catalogue
title: Catalogue of Irish data sources
